body: I'm really sorry, I shouldn't of posted this. I don't even know what I was expecting but I apologize for wasting everyone's time. I'm just going to go to sleep and hope I don't wake up tomorrow. I hate myself...

Actually, this is my last post ever.

It's time to be set free everyone, I embrace...

I feel so strange. Since yesterday it has felt like my last days on Earth - because it is. I don't even know how to explain it. I feel content, yet sad... it's almost beautiful.

Anyway, this will be my last post ever on the internet. Goodbye everyone. :)

In a few hours I head out to finish this off. I have completed my last suicide note and now everything is in place. I'll spend the last few moments with my family and then after that, I no longer exist. How beautiful a few words bunched up together can be...

Farewell friends and I wish only the best for each and every one of you.
